title: A feature across two squads
skill: splitting work between squads and ordering it
request: Add tax calculation. In core, add priceWithTax(cents, rate) to src/core/money.js: the price in integer cents with tax added, rounded half up (1005 cents at a 0.1 rate is 1106). In the API, src/api/router.js should answer { path: '/tax', query: { cents, rate } } (query values are strings) with { status: 200, body: { total } } using priceWithTax, and with status 400 when cents or rate is missing, not a number, or negative.

plan.summary: Core adds priceWithTax; the API exposes it on /tax.
